text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — elevated 5xx from API gateway to config-service (region us-west-2). Alert: gateway_5xx_rate > 8% for 3m. Correlation: spike in downstream timeouts to config-service.

oncall-rita: I’m on it. Looking at logs now. Can someone confirm impact — is this failing writes or reads?

kai: seeing timeouts for org config GETs (500/502). Reads failing; writes mostly OK but some proxy 504s.

dylan: Grafana — request rate to config-service up ~2x, error rate ramping. Link: https://grafana.internal/r/abc123 (dash).

support-emily: customer-facing tickets started to trickle in — a few customers reporting model provisioning failing with "config fetch failed". Not widespread yet but visible.

platform-sre: checking k8s— pods for config-service in us-west-2 are OOMKilled and backoff. Events show memory pressure and GC spikes.

oncall-rita: thanks. Initial mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback cache for API gateway to serve cached config for reads; 2) scale up config-service statefulset replicas + bump memory; 3) route a percentage of requests to us-east fallback config cluster. Any objections?

kai: +1 for cache fallback. How quickly can we flip that?

ops-bot: runbook snippet applied: 
```
# Toggle gateway cached-config mode
curl -X POST https://gateway-api.internal/config_cache/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"mode":"read-cache"}'
```

oncall-rita: executing cache toggle now.

oncall-rita: cache mode enabled (read-cache). Immediate drop in 5xx from gateway to config-service from 9.3% -> 2.1% (observed in 30s).

platform-sre: starting scale: `kubectl scale deploy/config-service --replicas=6 -n infra-us-west-2` and increasing memory request to 2Gi for each pod. Applying now.

dylan: routing change queued: starting canary route 10% to us-east config cluster via traffic-router.

kai: watch logs for cache misses — we should surface warnings for stale config. Also enable increased sampling for failed requests for postmortem.

support-emily: noting customer impact update: 18 customers reported failures across US-West. Most errors were transient and resolved after cache flip; 3 customers required manual retries. No billing impact reported.

platform-sre: new pods are starting, Memory pressure dropping. Error rate to config-service below 1% now.

oncall-rita: looks stable. I’ll keep monitoring for 30m then handoff. Can someone draft incident channel summary for customers?

support-emily: drafting blurb: "We experienced elevated internal errors while fetching configuration in us-west-2 between 12:14–12:28 UTC. We mitigated via gateway cache fallback and scaling config-service; the issue is resolved and we’re investigating root cause and next steps."

kai: collecting heap dumps from OOMKilled pods for root cause. Suspect a memory leak in the config LRU cache under load pattern.

platform-sre: opening a Jira: INF-3421 to track RCA and follow-ups (heap analysis, increase e2e caches, add horizontal autoscaling trigger on RSS).

oncall-rita: handoff to kai at 12:46 UTC for RCA. I’m marking incident as mitigated in the incident tracker and keeping watch.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED by oncall-rita at 12:46 UTC. Pages suppressed.

dylan: next steps: communicate in #customer-updates by EOD, schedule postmortem sync with infra and product to review caching and deployment sizing.

kai: grabbing the heap dumps now; will post artifacts to the Jira.

support-emily: any churn for customers we should proactively reach out to? I’ll pull list from support logs and coordinate messages.

oncall-rita: thanks team. Good triage and quick mitigations. Handoff complete.

platform-sre: note for postmortem — validate that gateway fallback respects TTLs and doesn't serve stale-critical flags.

incident-bot: auto-summary: "Mitigated elevated 5xx to gateway by enabling read-cache fallback, scaling config-service, and routing 10% to us-east. No loss of persisted data. Customers: 18 reported; 3 required manual retries. RCA ticket INF-3421 opened."
